question: Two light beams have the same frequency above threshold, but beam A has twice the intensity of beam B. Compare the energy of each photon and the number of photons incident per second in the two beams.

options.A: Since both beams have the same frequency, each photon has the same energy $E=h\nu$ in both beams. Beam A has twice the intensity, so it has twice the number of photons incident per second on the same area.
options.B: Each photon in beam A has twice the energy of a photon in beam B, but both beams have the same photon rate.
options.C: The photon energy and photon rate are both the same because the frequency is the same.
options.D: Beam A has the same photon energy but half the number of photons per second as beam B.
